title: fix: clarify Activity timestamps use UTC
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Clarifies that every date and time on the Activity page uses UTC
- Keeps the period picker, API windows, chart buckets, and event timestamps consistent
- Avoids partially localizing labels while the underlying periods remain UTC

Fixes #13651

Test: `/Users/thomash/Documents/GitHub/pollinations/node_modules/.bin/biome check enter.pollinations.ai/frontend/src/routes/_dashboard.activity.tsx`

gist.headline: Time zones, politely contained
gist.blurb: The Activity page now says the quiet part out loud: its clocks run on UTC. Polli put a tiny world clock next to the data so nobody has to guess what noon means.
gist.summary: Clarified that the Activity page's period picker, API windows, chart buckets, and event timestamps all use UTC.
gist.impact: Users can now interpret Activity data against one explicitly labeled UTC timeline instead of encountering partially localized labels over UTC-based periods.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tending a cozy dashboard garden beside a chunky retro world clock set to UTC, with chart bars and timestamped activity sprouts aligned to the same clock. The scene represents one consistent time standard across the Activity page.
